en.title: The 1.6 ETH trade that waited for one repayment
en.summary: A November 19 Ethereum block shows how a loan repayment reopened a stUSDS redemption window, and how execution order divided the proceeds.

zh.title: 等到一笔还款，才有这 1.6 ETH
zh.summary: 复盘 11 月 19 日的一段以太坊区块，拆解 stUSDS 的赎回额度、执行顺序与套利净收益。

en.title: Wintermute and the price of going first
en.summary: A $2.65m swap, a zero priority fee and nearly 6 ETH paid for ordering reveal which costs a public receipt can show.

zh.title: Wintermute 为什么愿意花钱买第一笔
zh.summary: 从一笔 265 万美元换币看零优先费背后的真实成本，再拆解机构如何为执行顺序定价。

en.title: Could the next GameStop squeeze start on a Saturday?
en.summary: Stock tokens give traders a weekend price. Whether that price moves the shares depends on who can carry the trade across markets.

zh.title: 下一场 GME 轧空，会从周六开始吗？
zh.summary: 股票代币让周末也有报价。这个价格能否传到美股，要看谁能把仓位从一边带到另一边。

en.title: If the AI trade breaks, which risk breaks first?
en.summary: The latest Alphabet and Microsoft results give us a baseline. Three stress scenarios separate valuations, rates and credit.

zh.title: 如果 AI 行情转向，先出问题的是估值、利率还是信用？
zh.summary: 用 Alphabet 和微软最新一季财报重做五月的压力测试，拆解三种下跌和不同保护工具的成本。

en.title: From one trading key to a 10.39m USDC outflow
en.summary: Inside the Lighter exploit, from signature failure to Ethereum settlement. A six-venue comparison of trading permissions, collateral custody, emergency exits, and the controls that hold up under test.

zh.title: 从一把交易密钥到千万 USDC 流出
zh.summary: 沿着 Lighter 的签名漏洞、公共池和以太坊结算追踪资金，再逐家拆解六大永续合约平台的交易权限、托管与应急退出路径，附可复现的安全验收清单。
